description: This file defines the AdminUserCreationController class, which extends AbstractInstallerVueController and manages the admin user creation step in the installer process of the OrangeHRM system. It sets up a Vue component and updates the state container.

classes.name: AdminUserCreationController
classes.description: Controller responsible for managing the admin user creation screen in the installer. It initializes the Vue component for the screen and updates the installer state.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component and updates the installer state before rendering the admin user creation screen.
